claim_ceiling: The exact Antigravity application and embedded language server completed one owner-assisted registered-project mem_current_project call through a fixed project entry. The MCP child used the filesystem root as its process cwd, so this does not establish workspace-derived resolution or general Antigravity support.
limitations: The exact tool-call execution timestamp was not retained; recorded_at is the later evidence-capture time on the same date.
The application MCP child used the filesystem root as its process cwd; the correct project came from the explicit project signal, not workspace-derived resolution.
The live language-server process received IDE override value 2.8.1, but that value is not treated as the language-server version; the bundled executable is bound by its exact hash.
No model-provider, account, subscription, or credential state was inspected or inferred.
No memory content was read or saved; memory read/write correctness was not tested.

Unregistered, missing-remote, explicit-mismatch, registry-collision, provider-unavailable, multi-project, clean-profile, credential-isolation, instruction-lifecycle, restart, and other-platform cases remain unrun.
A separate August 11 automated agy probe was already orphaned before this session and was terminated after the current app and CLI sessions exited cleanly; it is not attributed to this observation.
The post-quit probes are point-in-time evidence and do not establish crash, force-quit, or universal lifecycle behavior.
